$Comment: The Yeti Cave, Christmas's repeatable fight: the game's own Yeti camp (Yeti_Camps_YetiCamps_004, a
byte copy from the game's Assets.zip in the zip beside this file) as the Yeti's den, with a hall
dug out south of it. The camp is made to be carved into the ground, so on its own it would float in
the dungeon's empty world: Crop keeps only its ground (its dirt and ice floor, the low ring of shale
and ice around its brazier, the rubble), Skin opens the den and the hall to one height and wraps
them in two blocks of shale (walls, floor and roof), and Fills lays the snow floor and four ice
pillars. Every cell counts from the camp's anchor, three cells above its brazier, so y -4 is the
floor and y -3 where a player stands.
The den is 19 blocks across and 13 deep, the hall south of it 35 across and 37 long, both 14 high,
and a passage 5 wide leads south from the hall to the arrival spot and the way-out pad
(Leave_Instance) behind it. Nothing a player can climb stands more than two blocks high, and no
corner is too low for the Yeti, so he can always reach whoever he chases: a predator that cannot
walks home and heals. The fight's entity (Christmas_Yeti_Encounter) stands in the hall a little
north of its middle, and the Yeti's spawn marker between it and the den. Its reach and leash
(ArenaRange and the rest, in EncounterManager/Christmas/Christmas_Yeti_Encounter.json) count from
the entity's cell, so move them with it. The six Orbis_Boss_Health_Pack points are where health
packs may drop, and seven braziers light the hall and the passage beside the camp's own. Containers
sets a red Christmas Packet against the den's back wall, stocked from
Server/Drops/Christmas/Christmas_Drop_Yeti_Cave_Chest.json and full again on every paste. The cave
is high enough for the Yeti's snowballs, which start 10 blocks above the ring they fall on.
